scope: Scan8 מצותי in Deut11:13 and מצות in Numbers15:39 only. No claim that Unicode names identify distinct dots in the image.
decision: Retain primary U+05B9 HOLAM on consonantal vav, following the existing accepted Heidenheim–Marmorstein encoding. Do not alter a source dot or add another dot.
alternative_in_independent_reading: U+05BA HOLAM HASER FOR VAV; the independent full image review explicitly says the printed dot does not determine this codepoint choice.
limitation: The day-one file establishes an encoding convention, not proof of volume-two wording. Current source images and readers establish the actual volume-two spelling/pointing. Verify resulting PDF/HTML glyph placement in encoding/presentation review.
